Package org.lucas.models

Class Medicine

java.lang.Object
org.lucas.models.Medicine
public class Medicine extends Object
Represents a type of medicine, including its name, price, and methods for managing available medicines. This class supports creating medicine instances, finding medicines by name, and managing a list of available medicines through file I/O. It uses JSON serialization for persistence.

The class maintains a static list of available medicines, which is loaded from and saved to a file. This allows the application to retain medicine information across sessions.
